test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate one-word substitution of the given group of words.**

A similarity between like features of two things, on which a comparison may be based.
solution: The correct answer is: **Analogy** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Analogy **means a similarity or comparison between two things. (दो चीज़ों के बीच समानता या तुलना) • It is a word used to describe a comparison based on similarities. • **For example-** *The analogy between the human heart and a pump is often used to explain how blood circulates in the body.* • In the context of the given group of words: "A similarity between like features of two things, on which a comparison may be based," an analogy is precisely what is being described. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let us look at the meaning of the other words. • **Amalgamation **means the process of combining or uniting multiple things into one. (अनेक चीज़ों को एक में मिलाने या एक करने की प्रक्रिया) • **Apathy **means a lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern. (रुचि, उत्साह या चिंता की कमी) • **Ambiguity **means the quality of being open to more than one interpretation or having a double meaning. (एक से अधिक व्याख्या करने या दोहरा अर्थ रखने का गुण) 1d8:T96a, The correct answer is: **To avoid giving a definite answer or position**
